original_test_intent: Read and decode selected BMC LAN parameters for one channel and prove selector-specific raw values agree with the high-level LAN view and Project network baseline without changing reachability.
original_method: Query App 0x0C/0x02 with selectors Set In Progress, IP, source, MAC, mask, ARP control and gateway, using set/block 0/0 as specified; cross-check ipmitool lan print.
manual_activity: Network/FAE owner supplies the approved channel/selectors, expected baseline and redaction policy once; no per-run mutation approval is needed.
safety_requirements: Do not put password in argv/evidence
Do not call Set LAN automatically
Do not clear active Set In Progress
agent_execution_scope: Decode each parameter including ownership state
Archive redacted evidence with no mutation
engineer_actions: Interpret active ownership or unsupported selector

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek's lan print direction is only partial and its password argument is unsafe; it omits the explicit selector-level commands.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected credential injection to run the preserved bounded 0x0C/0x02 selector queries, parse each response and use lan print only as an independent cross-check.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The raw command, seven selectors, set/block values, lan-print comparison, Script URL and 10/5 timing remain preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run selector-specific protected reads with strict parsing/redaction, interpret Set In Progress ownership and compare both to Project baseline and lan print.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds secret-safe transport, field-level acceptance and redaction while retaining all source selectors.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: lan print alone may omit raw selector/set/block semantics and cannot prove the prescribed raw interface; raw completion alone cannot prove decoded agreement.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Network identity is sensitive and a wrong channel/selector parser can produce a false recovery baseline, especially when Set In Progress indicates another actor.

project_override_considerations: A Redfish/vendor inventory path is equivalent only if engineer-approved and it exposes all requested LAN fields plus ownership/freshness with comparable raw identity; original 0x02 command coverage remains unverified if skipped.
expected_evidence: Verified target/channel/selector scope and Project baseline
Redacted per-selector requests and complete responses
Decoded IP/source/MAC/mask/ARP/gateway and Set In Progress ownership

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The raw selector procedure and lan-print comparison Criteria align; read-only MAC note is consistent with this Get case.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The read operation and selectors are explicit. Channel, parser, baseline and redaction are execution-readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Restores the Master’s selector-level coverage, replaces unsafe credentials and unstructured user judgment with deterministic parsing, and prevents automatic network mutation on mismatch.
independent_technical_reasoning: Each LAN selector has its own response length and encoding, so comparing an unparsed raw byte string to human-readable lan print is insufficient. The test must decode canonical values first, preserve Set In Progress ownership semantics, and only then compare independent views; a mismatch is evidence to escalate, never authorization to rewrite network state.
